x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

import math

cur = math.gcd(x, y)
x //= cur
y //= cur

res = 10**9
resd = 1

if y <= n:
    print(f"{x}/{y}")
else:
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        cur = (x * i) // y
        if resd * abs(x * i - cur * y) < i * abs(x * resd - res * y):
            resd = i
            res = cur
        cur += 1
        if resd * abs(x * i - cur * y) < i * abs(x * resd - res * y):
            resd = i
            res = cur

    print(f"{res}/{resd}")
</translated_code>
